scope: B10 Node Broker process/pipe/request ownership checkpoint; does not complete Source/Mapper/Session memory work.
implementation: Complete packets no longer leave an empty subarray retaining their backing buffer.
Close and failure share one idempotent promise that waits for child close, even after failure set the closed flag.
All pending requests/timers are settled immediately; accumulated output, stderr and all three pipes are released.
Protocol/spawn/stream/timeout failures terminate the child; ignored SIGTERM escalates to SIGKILL with bounded timers, which are cleared on exit.

Oversized packet child ignores SIGTERM and is reaped after SIGKILL
